title: Parameter-free conditions for equality of general ridge estimators under spatial error models
summary: This paper investigates when two general ridge estimators coincide under spatial error models. First, in the general linear model, we derive a necessary and sufficient condition based on the commutativity of an extended dispersion matrix and an orthogonal projector, thereby extending the classical result of Zyskind. Next, we establish parameter-free conditions for first-order spatial autoregressive and spatial moving average processes.
